findings.message: Unsupported container setup: The only Dockerfile (docker/Dockerfile.nightly) copies nats-server, nsc, natscli, which the repository does not contain. Deployz builds the app from a Dockerfile in the repository.
Unsupported repository: docker/Dockerfile.nightly exposes port 4222 (NATS), so the image is a database or message-broker server that clients reach over its own protocol, not a web application.

The Dockerfile copies nats-server, nsc, natscli, which the repository does not contain (a build step makes it before docker build). Deployz builds from the repository only. Add a Dockerfile that builds the app from source, or select another Dockerfile.
